text: God Himself gave me the right to be called His child.
bibleVerseText: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.

text: God put His hands on me and called what He made — very good.
bibleVerseText: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

text: Jesus called me the light of the world — not someday, right now.
bibleVerseText: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

text: I have a Father who gave me His name and called me His son.
bibleVerseText: For you did not receive a spirit that makes you a slave again to fear, but you received the spirit of sonship.

text: I am chosen, royal, and set apart — God's own possession from the start.
bibleVerseText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession.

text: I am the righteousness of God — not because I earned it, but because Christ did.
bibleVerseText: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

text: The Holy Spirit of God lives inside me — I am His temple, His home.
bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you?

text: God chose me before the world was made — before I could do anything.
bibleVerseText: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in his sight.

text: The One who loves me calls me more than a conqueror — and He means it.
bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

text: I am God's masterpiece — made by Him, not an accident, not a mistake.
bibleVerseText: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

text: Everything that belongs to God belongs to me — I am His heir through Christ.
bibleVerseText: Now if we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ.

text: I am not strong because of what I achieve — I am strong in God.
bibleVerseText: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

text: My life is hidden with Christ in God — locked in, safe, and untouchable.
bibleVerseText: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

text: God's love for me has no start date, no end date, and no condition.
bibleVerseText: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

text: God put me at the top — not at the bottom, not as an afterthought.
bibleVerseText: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God...you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.

text: I carry the authority of the King who sent me — I am His ambassador.
bibleVerseText: We are therefore Christ's ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us.

text: The verdict over my life is final: no condemnation. Not guilty. Set free.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

text: I am the salt of the earth — I change everything just by being here.
bibleVerseText: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

text: My citizenship is in heaven — this world's rejections don't have the final word.
bibleVerseText: But our citizenship is in heaven. And we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.

text: I am dead to everything that tried to define me — and alive to God.
bibleVerseText: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

text: Jesus called me His friend — He shares His secrets with me and He means it.
bibleVerseText: I no longer call you servants... Instead, I have called you friends.

text: God sealed me with His Spirit — marked as His, and that seal never breaks.
bibleVerseText: You were marked in him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit.

text: God knew me before He formed me — I had a name before the world did.
bibleVerseText: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart.

text: God called me good and He does not lie — His word over me stands forever.
bibleVerseText: God is not human, that he should lie, not a human being, that he should change his mind.

text: Before the world had a name, God had mine — chosen, holy, and without blame.
bibleVerseText: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in his sight.

text: God said, 'I will be your Father' — and I am His son, not His servant.
bibleVerseText: I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.

text: My worth was settled at the cross — it doesn't move with my performance or failures.
bibleVerseText: You were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.

text: God already gave me everything I need for life — not someday, but now, fully.
bibleVerseText: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him.

text: The blood of Jesus cleaned me completely — shame has no case against me.
bibleVerseText: The blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

text: I don't have to earn what God freely gives — I am already loved, already accepted.
bibleVerseText: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

text: I was hand-selected by God for something the world will never fully understand.
bibleVerseText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession, that you may declare the praises of him who called you.

text: God called me by name and said, 'You are mine' — and that word stands.
bibleVerseText: I have summoned you by name; you are mine.

text: In Christ I am a new creation — the old me is gone for good.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

text: In Christ I am complete — nothing missing, nothing broken, nothing to be added.
bibleVerseText: And in Christ you have been brought to fullness.

text: I carry the peace of One who already won — and His victory is mine.
bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.
